いま、現場のどこで
つまずいていますか。

採用、販売、ITまで。

部門をまたぐ原因と
改善の優先順位を整理します。

ばらつきがある

見直したい

Web・OTA・営業が
宿泊収益につながらない

現場で使い切れていない

This is a fully composed raster UI with exact Japanese text, not a photo asset. No browser chrome, phone frame, outer margins, presentation annotations or invented copy.
DESIGN SYSTEM: physical output ideally twice logical dimensions. Design for 390px screen width, side padding 24px, text area 342px. Japanese body 15px (30px at 780px wide), readable sans serif medium/regular, line height 25px. Section Japanese headings 30px (60 at 780), refined Japanese Mincho serif, line height 43px. Supporting labels 13px (26 at 780), never smaller than 12px logical. Large English uses strong condensed grotesk. Navy #0E2233, warm paper #F4F1EB, restrained burnt orange #CE773F. High contrast text; on orange buttons use navy lettering. Thin rules, purposeful spacious composition, no rounded cards, no tiny text. Strictly single-column mobile reflow. CTA height 56px and width 342px; smaller controls 44px. Pixel sizes above are at logical width390 and must scale with actual image width. All copy in COPY must appear, exactly; line breaks can move only at Japanese meaning boundaries. Render Japanese glyphs carefully, do not substitute or summarize. Do not add English labels, slogans, facts or navigation that are not in COPY.
CANVAS: target 780×1800px, portrait ratio 390:900; final display 390×900px. Full canvas is this one section, never a full-page overview. Use entire height with readable type; no compressed miniature page.
REFERENCE ROLES: Attached accepted mobile hero is the actual typography, palette, material and photo-world style reference. Do not repeat its header, hero copy or branding in this section unless listed below.
COMPOSITION: Top navy title area 200px then 300px full width lounge photograph, stone table foreground warm lamps and glass, mountains in background. Lower navy vertical 6-step timeline with orange line, spacious 56px rows. No new explanations.
EDGES: Top edge #0E2233; bottom edge #0E2233. Flat edge colours, no outer stroke, no vignette along left/right paper edges. Start chapter label 48px from top; finish after 40px breathing space. Clear visual hierarchy; don't distribute text into tiny distant islands.

現場の行動へ。"
"05 / 実行から引継ぎまで"
